entities.summary: Oderah "O. D." Anosike is an American professional basketball player who last played for the Gaziantep Basketbol of the Türkiye Basketbol Ligi (TBL). He played college basketball for Siena College. In the 2011–12 NCAA Division I season, Anosike led Division I in rebounding, with a 12.5 per game average. He then repeated as the country's top rebounder in 2012–13, with an 11.4 per game average.
